invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.
Protocol identity, named listener instance, route/address/channel binding and domain operation identity remain separate; protocol exposure never creates semantic ownership or authorization.
Protocols expose or transport canonical operations/data but never become semantic owner or bypass canonical authority.

prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define explicit mapping from listener/protocol instance to application route/address/handler identities without inferring application semantics from URL/path/topic names. [2] Define explicit bindings from REST routes, OSC addresses, WebSocket channels/topics or other protocol selectors to exact canonical operations/resources. [3] Define exact bindings from protocol-facing routes/addresses/channels to canonical operations, resources, events or views without encoding ownership in the external route.

semantics.ambiguity_rule: Overlapping routes resolve through explicit precedence/specificity semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Route existence never grants operation authority. [2] Binding existence does not grant caller access; AccessCore is still evaluated.
semantics.change_rule: Binding edits are canonical configuration changes and may require listener reload.
semantics.collision_rule: Conflicting active bindings hard-fail unless multiplexing semantics are explicit.
semantics.conflict_rule: Ambiguous duplicate active selectors hard-fail unless explicit precedence semantics exist.
semantics.direction_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Read/write/invoke/subscribe/publish direction is explicit where applicable. [2] Binding declares read/write/invoke/subscribe/publish semantics as applicable.
semantics.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Route binding identity is distinct from underlying operation/resource identity. [2] Selector string is a binding, not the semantic identity of the target.
semantics.ownership_rule: Route/address/channel never becomes owner of target semantics.
semantics.route_rule: Route/path/address/topic pattern is explicit binding metadata.
semantics.schema_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Input/output payload schema/profile is explicit. [2] Protocol input/output mapping is explicit and validated.
semantics.selector_rule: Protocol selector is explicit and exact within its protocol-instance scope.
semantics.target_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Target application handler/operation surface is exact. [2] Binding target resolves exact canonical operation/resource identity. [3] Every binding targets an explicit canonical identity.
